sample_intro: Every component from the shared UI library, in a library setting.
sample_buttons_description: One primary action per screen; everything else stays quiet.
sample_form_description: Details used to find the book in your library.
sample_form_isbn_error: This ISBN has {count} digits: enter 10 or 13.
sample_form_isbn_copy_failed: The browser did not allow copying.
sample_form_shelf_hint: Not editable: assigned by the library.
sample_form_saved: {title} has been added to the catalogue.
nav_description: Pages of the library and your account.
home_intro: Your library, kept in order like a reading room.
home_sign_in_prompt: Sign in to open your catalogue.
profile_details_description: How you appear to other readers and on your loans.
profile_display_name_hint: Your full name, or the name you prefer to be called.
profile_display_name_too_long: Shorten the display name to {max} characters or fewer.
profile_email_hint: Used to sign in. Change it in your sign-in account.
profile_save_failed: Your profile could not be saved. Try again in a moment.
profile_reading_room_description: How the library looks and speaks to you. Changes apply straight away.
profile_role_description: Your role is set by an administrator. Ask one if you need to do more in the library.
profile_role_empty: You have no role yet: you can use the library, but not manage it.
profile_early_access_description: Features still being finished, open to you before the rest of the library.
profile_security_description: Your password, sign-in methods and open sessions are kept by your sign-in account.
forbidden_title: You don’t have access to this page
forbidden_description: Your roles don’t include the permission this page needs. Ask an administrator if you need it.
users_intro: Everyone with a reader’s card: their roles, and whether they can sign in.
user_no_account: No sign-in account was found for this user: it may have been deleted.
user_details_description: How this user appears to other readers.
user_action_failed: That change could not be made. Reload the page and try again.
user_role_description_edit: Every user has one role, which sets their permissions. Choosing another role replaces it; a role can’t be taken away without giving another.
user_role_description_read_only: This user’s role and the permissions it gives.
user_role_description_self: You cannot change your own role: ask another administrator.
user_account_description: Whether this user can sign in to the library.
user_block_explain_blocked: This user is blocked and cannot sign in.
user_delete_description: Removes the sign-in account and everything kept for this user. This cannot be undone.
user_not_found_description: This user does not exist, or has been deleted.
flags_intro: Features still being tried out, and the readers who can use them before everyone else.
flags_new_description: Code checks the key, so it can’t be changed once the flag exists.
flags_key_hint: Capital letters, digits and underscores, like BOOK_SEARCH.
flags_key_format: Use only capital letters and digits, with single underscores between words.
flags_key_taken: Another flag already has this key.
flags_description_hint: What the flag turns on, for the other administrators. Optional.
flags_create_failed: The flag could not be created. Try again in a moment.
flag_settings_description: What the flag is for. The key stays as it is: code checks it.
flag_holders_description: The users who have the flag, latest grants first. Select some to take it back.
flag_holders_empty: Nobody has been granted this flag yet.
flag_grant_description: Find users by name, select them, and grant them the flag.
flag_grant_empty: Every user has this flag already.
flag_grant_empty_search: No user without the flag has a name matching “{query}”.
flag_delete_description: Removes the flag and every grant of it, so nobody has the feature any more. This cannot be undone.
flag_delete_confirm: Delete “{key}” and every grant of it for good?
flag_not_found_description: This flag does not exist, or has been deleted.
list_load_failed: More entries could not be loaded.
book_new_intro: Start with the ISBN printed on the back cover or the copyright page: what the book catalogues know about it is filled in for you to check.
book_isbn_hint: 10 or 13 digits; hyphens and spaces are fine.
book_isbn_sources: Details come from Open Library, Google Books, the Bibliothèque nationale de France (Licence Ouverte) and the NDL Search API.
book_isbn_found: Details found and filled in. Check them, and add anything missing, before adding the book.
book_isbn_not_found: No book catalogue knows this ISBN. Fill in the details yourself.
book_isbn_invalid: This is not a valid ISBN: check the digits.
book_isbn_exists: “{title}” is already in the catalogue with this ISBN.
book_isbn_unavailable: The book catalogues can’t be reached right now. Try again later, or fill in the details yourself.
book_isbn_failed: The ISBN could not be looked up. Try again in a moment.
book_work_description: The book as written, whichever edition you hold.
book_title_error: Enter the title, in up to {max} characters.
book_contributors_hint: Translators and narrators are credited on this edition, everyone else on the work.
book_first_published_hint: The year the work first appeared.
book_series_position_error: Enter a number, like 1 or 2.5, and the series it belongs to.
book_genres_hint: Type to find a genre; choose one or more.
book_subjects_hint: Genres and topics, separated by commas.
book_subjects_error: Enter up to 20 subjects, each up to 100 characters.
book_edition_description: The published form you hold: its publisher, format and cover.
book_edition_statement_hint: When the book says so, like “2nd edition”.
book_published_hint: A year, or a full date like 1937-09-21.
book_published_error: Enter a year, or a date like 1937-09-21.
book_number_error: Enter a whole number above zero.
book_language_error: Choose a language from the list.
book_cover_hint: The web address of a picture of the cover.
book_cover_error: Enter a web address starting with https://.
book_create_failed: The book could not be added. Try again in a moment.
book_isbn_taken: “{title}” already has this ISBN: it is in the catalogue.
books_intro: Every book in the library, filed by title.
books_search_label: Search by title, author, series or ISBN
book_not_found_description: This book does not exist, or it was removed from the catalogue.
book_editions_empty: No edition of this book is recorded.
book_edit_intro: The catalogue is shared: every reader sees these changes.
book_edit_contributors_hint: Translators and narrators are credited on each edition instead.
book_series_name_error: Enter the series this number belongs to, in up to 200 characters.
book_edition_title_hint: Only when it differs from the book’s, as in a translation.
book_edition_contributors_hint: People credited on this edition only, like its translator.
book_save_failed: The changes could not be saved. Try again in a moment.
book_gone: This is no longer in the catalogue.
book_delete_description: Removes the book and all its editions from the catalogue, for every reader. Its authors, series, publishers and subjects stay. This cannot be undone.
book_delete_confirm: Delete “{title}” and its editions ({count}) for good?
book_delete_failed: The book could not be deleted. Try again in a moment.
book_edition_delete_description: Removes this edition from the catalogue, for every reader. The book and its other editions stay. This cannot be undone.
book_edition_delete_description_only: This is the book’s only edition: the book stays in the catalogue without any. To remove it too, delete the book instead. This cannot be undone.
book_edition_delete_confirm: Delete this edition of “{title}” for good?
book_edition_delete_failed: The edition could not be deleted. Try again in a moment.
